notes: The title says the list is 'from continentals' and the description says 'this is not my deck, but this is what i played.' Snider's report 'geoff-goes-to-continentals' (DeckTech, 6 August 2001) describes this deck ('the pile') on Day 2 of the 2001 North American Continental Championship: a win over an MKOS deck, a loss to Corey Faherty (MKOS) and a win over Dave Irvine (ISB/Scum) — 2–1 with this deck. Part 2 of the report gives his finish as 'i took 7th??? (maybe 8th???)'.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: the list has no Coruscant-set cards (event was 3–4 August 2001, before Coruscant was tournament legal).

Cards marked (S) as posted: Tatooine: Slave Quarters ('shmi's hut'), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Scrambled Transmission, Don't Do That Again and Your Insight Serves You Well. No Objective. All count toward the 60.
Posted '8x 2/0' (under locations 9) names no sites: printed as written (UNKNOWN, 8 cards).
Posted 'sense/uncertain x2' dested Sense & Recoil In Fear: Sense & Uncertain Is The Future is the Dark combo; the Light Sense combo is Sense & Recoil In Fear.

Posted 'naked droid' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (the strategy uses it to get an interrupt back; the report says 'get 3p0 and start cycling'); 'corn horn' Corran Horn; 'weapon lev' the Light Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace); 'shock/grimtaash' Shocking Information & Grimtaash.

Posted 'qui-gon's lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine); Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is a Reflections III card (October 2001). 'qui-gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'jedi luke' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'epp obi' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'epp han' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'epp leia' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'chewie protector' Chewbacca, Protector; 'lando w/axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax.
Sense and Alter are posted without a set and use the plain pages.
player_note: Snider wrote that this is not his own deck design, but that it is the list he played.
